[[File:Ravenous ghoul icon.png|left]]
The '''ravenous ghoul''' is a monster found in the [[Slayer Tower Mausoleum|mausoleum]] below the graveyard north of [[Canifis]].

The crypt can be entered via a [[Mausoleum entrance (Slayer Tower)|trapdoor]] in the south east corner of the [[Slayer Tower]], as well as [[Mausoleum (Slayer Tower)|another entrance]] to the east of the [[lustrous wisp]] colony.

It is not recommended to slay these for the [[Ghoul Champion's scroll]] as they have significantly higher life points with the same drop rate as normal [[ghoul]]s and they cannot be cannoned, as their crypts do not allow setting up a [[dwarf multicannon]]. If the player has a [[blood essence]] equipped, all ghouls in the crypt will become aggressive. This also works for ravenous ghouls placed in the [[Sunken Pyramid]]. The blood essence does not need charges for their aggressiveness.

They are considered ghouls for the [[Ghouls (Slayer assignment)|regular ghoul Slayer assignment]].
